title: Mail Fell To 109 Billion Pieces While Stamps Got Pricier
hook: Mail fell to 109 billion pieces, yet stamps kept getting pricier.
closing: A shrinking mailbox does not shrink delivery costs, so every remaining letter carries more pressure.
question: What still makes you buy stamps?

segments.say: USPS mail volume fell to 109 billion pieces. The mailbox is thinning even while the delivery network remains.
First-Class Mail dropped to 46 billion pieces. Personal and business letters are disappearing faster than mail overall.
A First-Class stamp reached 68 cents. Sending fewer letters did not make each letter cheaper.
